title: Slide & Fold uPVC Doors
whatIsIt: A bi-fold panel system where each leaf folds and slides back concertina-style, opening the entire width of the wall.
whyChooseIt: The only door style that gives you a full 100% opening — when you want indoor and outdoor space to genuinely merge into one room, this is the system that does it.
idealFor: Villas connecting living rooms to gardens

benefits.title: 100% opening
benefits.description: Folds completely to one side, removing the barrier between spaces entirely.

benefits.title: Weather performance of a casement
benefits.description: Maintains sealing comparable to casement systems even with multiple folding joints.

benefits.title: Built for wind and rain
benefits.description: Sturdy against heavy winds and rain — installation requires structural analysis for safety.

designOptions: Multi-panel folding configurations sized to the opening; structural analysis required before installation.

series.description: A bi-fold system providing full 100% opening capability while maintaining weather performance comparable to casement systems — suited to high-rise balconies and villa applications that merge interior and exterior spaces.
